title: Apple launches HomeView, a Siri-powered smart home hub
description:
Apple just unveiled a $299 smart home hub that claims to recognize you by sight. We’re breaking down if this is the upgrade your house needs or just another screen on your counter.

What we covered:
• Apple launches HomeView, a Siri-powered smart home hub
• Meta Launches Muse Wonder Frontier AI Models
• Character.AI files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy and agrees to sell some assets to Disney

Three distinct AI stories, with lively debate, useful discoveries and practical takeaways.

Listener question: Would you pay $299 for a smart home hub that recognizes you and personalizes your home screen?

What to watch tomorrow: not which AI headline was loudest, but which one quietly changed the rules.

Alex, Jamie and Rufus tell you what changed in AI, who wins, and what you do next.
